levels.mission: A freshly deployed pod keeps flapping between Running and CrashLoopBackOff. Work through the evidence before you touch the cluster.

lines: Error: env DATABASE_URL is required but was empty
Warning  BackOff   restarting failed container web
Normal   Pulled    Container image "web:1.4" already present

opts.t: The container image tag does not exist in the registry
A required environment variable is missing from the spec
The node is out of memory and evicting the pod
The readiness probe path returns 404
Add the missing DATABASE_URL env var to the container spec
Increase the CPU limit and redeploy
Disable the liveness probe
Rebuild and re-push the Docker image

levels.hint: The container exits on startup — before any probe runs. Read the --previous logs.

levels.mission: After migrating to a private registry, the web pod can no longer start. Images that were accessible yesterday now fail to pull entirely.

lines: Warning  Failed    Failed to pull image "registry.internal/web:2.0"

opts.t: The image tag 2.0 does not exist in the registry
No imagePullSecrets configured — nodes cannot auth to the private registry
The container port mapping is wrong
The node is cordoned and cannot pull images
Create a docker-registry Secret and add it to the pod spec under imagePullSecrets
Change the image tag to latest
Delete the pod and let it reschedule
Rebuild the image and push it again

levels.hint: A 401 means authentication failed. Kubernetes needs a Secret of type docker-registry to pull from private registries.

levels.mission: A new service has an init container that runs DB migrations before the main app starts. The pod is stuck in Init:CrashLoopBackOff — the main container never launches.

lines: dial tcp: connect to postgres.default.svc:5432: connection refused

opts.t: The init container image is corrupted and cannot run
DB_HOST points to the wrong namespace — the database lives in the data namespace
Init containers cannot access environment variables
The main container is blocking the init container from completing
Update DB_HOST to postgres.data.svc.cluster.local to reach the correct namespace
Delete the init container definition entirely
Add a longer sleep before the migration runs
Switch to a newer version of the migration image

levels.hint: Kubernetes DNS is <svc>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local. The init container resolves the wrong namespace.
